messages:
sam (AE): Quick sync — enterprise just signed MSA. They want a short POC + committed reservation. Target ~100k qps-month, peaks ~5k RPS. Need a concise reserved config, preheat/runbook, burst policy, and a pricing sketch for fp16 vs 4-bit quant. Also security: customer-managed KMS + 13mo logs.
rita (sales_eng): noted. They pushed hard on p99 token latency ~200ms. Also asked about quantized model licensing.
kai (solutions): Recommend baseline 6 reserved GPUs (A100-80 equiv) with burst credits to allow +50% (up to 9). AZ split 3+3. KV-cache warmup will materially cut token compute for sessioned chat.
leo (infra): Ops — autoscale guidance: scale_up if gpu_util > 70% for 30s -> +1 GPU; scale_down if gpu_util < 30% for 5m -> -1 GPU. Burst policy: +50% capacity for up to 4h via burst credits.
leo (infra): Preheat (short runbook):
- T-120m: kick off kv-warmup across reserved gpus
- T-90m: synthetic @50% for 30m
- T-60m: synthetic @75% for 45m, validate p99
- T-0: enable burst credits for initial ramp
kai (solutions): Smoke commands (examples): `./kv-warmup --model mix-quant --sessions 1200 --concurrency 120` and `./loadgen --rps 3750 --ctx 2000 --duration 45m`. Pass criteria: error rate <0.5% and p99 token <=200ms.
rita (sales_eng): Pricing ask: quick low/med/high for 6-GPU baseline fp16 vs 4-bit quant so I can finish the quote.
kai (solutions): Ballpark: fp16 ~ "$72k/mo" for 6 GPUs. 4-bit quant + batching -> ~40-50% lower -> "$36k-$44k/mo". Burst billed at marginal premium (~+10%). I'll follow with a short calc.
legal: We can accept customer-managed KMS + audit-forwarding for 13mo retention on Dedicated. Private only if they require on-prem/air-gap. Also add model-licensing clause if customer brings a licensed quantized model.
sam (AE): Can we offer conditional SLO language for coldstarts? Customer wants something contractual for p99.
legal: Yes — conditional SLO: "P99 latency SLO of 200ms while the agreed preheat runbook (KV warmup + synthetic smoke) is executed; otherwise best-effort." We'll draft exact wording and an ops appendix.
rita (sales_eng): For the AE deck I'll paste this autoscale snippet: {min_reserved_gpus:6, max_total_gpus:9, scale_up_threshold:0.7, scale_down_threshold:0.3, burst_limit_hours_per_month:120}.
leo (infra): Ops recommendation: run a 10% -> 50% -> 100% canary on day one and keep automatic fallback to a quantized variant if latency breaches.
kai (solutions): Next steps: I'll post a 1-pager calc with per-GPU breakout and sensitivity for model variants in 30m. Leo will attach the preheat checklist. Legal will drop SLO appendix. Rita/Sam: you can finish the AE deck after that.
sam (AE): Thanks all. Ping here when docs are attached. :white_check_mark:
